args.query: Litestar app with msgspec Struct request bodies and dependency injection

results.title: Litestar app with DI, role guards and exception handlers
results.summary: A Litestar app with a dependency-injected repository, a role guard on DELETE, and a custom exception handler, tested offline with create_test_client and an in-memory fake.

results.title: Litestar app with advanced-alchemy and DTOs on SQLite
results.summary: A Litestar app wired to SQLAlchemy through the advanced-alchemy plugin, with separate read and write DTOs over aiosqlite, tested offline with litestar.testing TestClient.

results.title: msgspec Structs with tagged unions, constraints and fast codecs
results.summary: Define msgspec Structs with tagged unions and Meta constraints, encode and decode JSON and MessagePack, inspect ValidationError paths, and convert plain dicts, all tested offline.

results.title: orjson and msgspec encode/decode parity helpers
results.summary: Run orjson and msgspec side by side with canonical sort-key and non-str-key options, a shared Struct hook and typed decoding, and pin down where their bytes diverge.

results.title: msgspec Structs to JSON Schema with constraints and tagged unions
results.summary: Generate JSON Schema from msgspec Structs using Annotated Meta constraints, tagged unions and optional fields, then decode payloads with the same validation rules.

results.title: msgspec tagged union Structs over MessagePack and JSON
results.summary: Model a tagged union of msgspec Structs, round-trip it through MessagePack and JSON, and verify tag selection and strict-field validation under pytest.

results.title: Awilix dependency injection with scoped request containers
results.summary: Wire services with an Awilix container in PROXY mode using asClass, asFunction and asValue, singleton, scoped and transient lifetimes, per-request scopes and disposers.

results.title: FastAPI routes wired to a dependency-injector DeclarativeContainer, tested offline
results.summary: Build a DeclarativeContainer with Configuration, Singleton and Factory providers, wire it into FastAPI routes with @inject and Depends(Provide[...]), and test it in-process with httpx.ASGITransport.

results.title: FastAPI dependency_overrides tested offline with httpx ASGITransport
results.summary: Override FastAPI dependencies (including nested ones) and drive the app in-process with httpx.ASGITransport, no network and no running server.

results.title: injector Modules, @provider, singleton scope and ClassAssistedBuilder
results.summary: Wire a small app with injector Modules, a @provider method, singleton-scoped services and ClassAssistedBuilder assisted construction, then override bindings with a test module.
